rubricScores.criterion: Found the MSB3073 error in the DataSources project's signing step and identified the specific file(s) that failed
Traced the failing file to its origin — placed in shared output folder by a different project
Discovered multiple projects set Distrib to same ConfigurationLinterService path
Identified CAS read-only hard links making files unsignable
Explained non-determinism based on target ordering/race
Proposed removing Distrib/Robocopy from library projects so service project owns folder

scenarios.scenario: Deep — Full autonomous root cause investigation and fix proposal
scenarios.reasoning: Efficient, methodical investigation (35 calls, quick recovery from path-format errors) with concrete binlog node citations for nearly every claim. All six required deliverables addressed with actionable fixes. Main weakness: the read-only/CAS hard-link mechanism was reinterpreted as a sharing violation, and the mechanism claim (CoW links causing concurrent lock) is somewhat speculative; final verification step is light.
